items.performers: Gidon Kremer and Tatjana Grindenko (violins); Alfred Schnittke (prepared piano); Lithuanian Chamber Orchestra; Saulius Sondeckis (conductor)
items.label: ECM New Series
items.note: Two solo violins lead this double concerto through eight variations before the slow ‘Silentium’, in which the voices move at different speeds. Kremer and Grindenko, the violin soloists at the première, are joined by Alfred Schnittke on prepared piano on the album that launched ECM’s New Series.

items.work: Spiegel im Spiegel — violin and piano
items.label: ECM New Series
items.note: The violin’s phrases lengthen above three-note piano arpeggios, returning each time to A. Spivakov, the work’s dedicatee, and Bezrodny open Alina with this version, recorded in Frankfurt’s Festeburgkirche with Pärt present.

items.work: Passio Domini nostri Jesu Christi secundum Joannem
items.performers: The Hilliard Ensemble; Michael George (bass); John Potter (tenor); Christopher Bowers-Broadbent (organ); The Western Wind Chamber Choir; Paul Hillier (conductor)
items.label: ECM New Series
items.note: Four singers share the Evangelist’s words in Pärt’s Latin St John Passion, and an organ accompanies Jesus and Pilate. The Hilliard Ensemble’s recording with Paul Hillier, made in St Jude’s on the Hill in London, brought the work to international attention.
